reviews.text: Gabriel and his team were awesome. They are hardworking, patient and kind. We hired Complete Home Remodeling Services for a kitchen remodel last summer. On top of remodeling the kitchen we changed out rear sliding doors, resided the rear of the home, changed out our hose bibs and had multiple areas of drywall patched where we had ductwork moved. The work was completed within the timeframe provided and any issues that arose were addressed immediately. The work speaks for itself and the outcome is beautiful. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 2 weeks ago

Thank you, Corey, for taking the time to share such a thoughtful review. We sincerely appreciate the trust you placed in Complete Home Remodeling Services for your kitchen remodel and additional home improvements. Our team takes great pride in delivering quality workmanship, staying on schedule, and addressing every detail throughout the project. It was a pleasure working with you, and we truly appreciate your recommendation.

Gabriel Galeano

reviews.text: Gabriel and the men who work for him are polite, kind, clean and professional, I couldn't recommend them more. Gabriel did a complete bathroom remodel for me at a great price. I had an issue a few months after and Gabriel took care of it immediately. He went above and beyond to make sure I was happy. I can not recommend them enough and will have them back to do my kitchen when I'm ready.
reviews.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 2 weeks ago
“Thank you, Elizabeth, for your wonderful review and for trusting Complete Home Remodeling Services with your project. We sincerely appreciate your kind words about our team, professionalism, and workmanship. Customer satisfaction is always our priority, and we’re glad we were able to address your concerns promptly. It was a pleasure working with you, and we look forward to helping you with your kitchen remodel when you’re ready. 



Gabriel Galeano
CHRS LLC

reviews.text: Our experience with Complete Home Remodeling Services has been excellent! We had both our bathrooms remodeled and they turned out beautifully. Gabriel is very detailed with his proposals and we appreciate his transparency and flexibility with providing us options. His team did amazing work and were very kind/respectful while in our home. They even help do some patch work on our cracked ceilings in other rooms. The photos highlight the showers as I love how they turned out, the niche is my favorite. I would recommend Gabriel and his team over and over again. Plus I now have someone I am highly confident in to call for future projects!
